subStrands.name: Battery Concepts, Types, Charging and Testing

objectives.description: Concept of battery: definition, distinction between motor vehicle battery and other batteries.
Uses of battery: vehicle battery assembly and as power source in soldering.
Types, constructional details and ratings: lead-acid and nickel-alkaline types.
Charging: safety rules, electrolyte preparation, battery cleaning and connection, charging mode, state of charge, electrolyte testing.

Testing and maintenance: specific gravity test of electrolyte, cell voltage and polarity tests, tools and equipment; electrolyte topping up, hydrometer reading and interpretation, over-charging symptoms and idle-battery safe-keeping.

subStrands.name: Components, Circuit Diagram, Types and Repair

objectives.description: Purpose and components of starting system: battery, flywheel, starter motor, switch and solenoid.
Circuit diagram: drawing and reading of circuit diagram including location of components and their sequential arrangement in a vehicle.
Types of starter motor: axial and inertia; treatment should include pinion engagements.

Repair of starter motors: dismantling and assembling, bushing and brush replacement, commutator soldering/repair, troubleshooting and rectification; armature servicing, diagnosis and repairs/restoration.
Purpose and components of ignition system: circuit cables, ignition switch, battery, coil, distributor, capacitor, high tension leads and sparking plugs.
Circuit diagram: drawing and reading of circuit diagram including line diagram and conventional symbols.
Construction and operation of ignition coil: circuit diagram and internal construction of the coil.
Types of ignition system: conventional contact breaker and electronic ignition systems.
Timing: concept and timing faults such as retarded ignition and over-advanced ignition.
Faults and repairs: hard starting, jerking, back firing etc; use of multimeter, scanner, test lamps etc.
Purpose and components of charging system: switch, battery, cables, alternators, voltage regulators.
Alternator: constructional details, conversion of a.c. to d.c. (rectification), function of each part of an alternator.
Circuit diagram: drawing and reading of circuit diagram including graphical and pictorial representation; how to remove and fix the charging system units.
Faults and repairs: brush and bearing replacement, diode testing, repair and replacement; bearing seizure, charging failure etc.

subStrands.name: Classification, Head Lamps, Circuit Diagram and Maintenance

objectives.description: Purpose and classification of lighting in a motor vehicle: obligatory and non-obligatory lights; types, features, setting of head lamps.
Head lamps: classification, drawing and reading of circuit diagram; troubleshooting.
Maintenance and repairs: tools, equipment and procedures for repairing faults such as broken headlamp lens, bulb failure, non-aligned headlamps, open and short circuits etc.

Concept and components of auxiliary system: definition, uses and units; water temperature gauge, oil pressure gauge, fuel gauge, horn relay, wiper switch, screen washer pump, indicator and door switch.
Constructional details and operation of auxiliary system components.

Maintenance and repairs of auxiliary components: troubleshooting; tools and equipment and procedures for repairs of faults such as the failure of horn, screen wiper, oil pressure gauge, fuel gauge etc.
